why: This is a study-specific named assessment instrument rather than a general instructional element; its item format is covered by Selected-Response Assessment Items.
name: VNS masterclass MCQ assessment
product_description: A 14-item multiple-choice assessment with 67 binary propositions and fractional scoring, designed by Barrit Sami et al. to measure neurosurgeons’ practical knowledge for safe and effective vagus nerve stimulation implementation.
